repos_data.description: Memory layer for AI Agents. Replace complex RAG pipelines with a serverless, single-file memory layer. Give your agents instant retrieval and long-term memory.
Open-source, self-hosted knowledge backend for AI agents — hybrid search (vector + keyword), MCP server, 5 connectors, Docker-ready
Memory engine for AI agents — time axis (3-layer decay/promotion) + space axis (self-organizing topic tree). Hybrid search, LLM consolidation. Single Rust binary.

Embedded long-term memory database for AI agents & LLM apps. Six-layer cognitive architecture, knowledge graph, hybrid BM25 + vector search, sleep-time memory consolidation. One .meh file, zero infrastructure, pure Go.
Open-source persistent memory for AI agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and Claude. REST API + knowledge graph + autonomous consolidation.
Agentic AI memory with Ebbinghaus forgetting curve decay. +16pp better recall than Mem0 on LoCoMo.
A personal knowledge graph for Claude that survives across sessions, devices, and tools. Neo4j + semantic embeddings, OAuth-secured, single-user-by-default but multi-tenant-ready.
Local-first memory engine for AI-agent teams — private/team/project ACL, associative recall, federated sync, and a built-in MCP server. One SQLite file, no LLM required. Apache-2.0.
Durable hybrid memory for AI agents: vector + BM25 + temporal + graph recall, exposed through MCP, HTTP, and Python.

Local-first, deterministic memory store for AI agents: SQLite-backed BM25 with optional local ONNX semantic search and cross-encoder rerank, graph projection, and an MCP adapter. No required network or LLM.
Local, LLM-free memory for AI agents. A single offline Rust binary — deterministic and auditable — that learns from use, forgets the irrelevant, and strengthens what matters. No cloud, no API keys.
🧠 Persistent memory for AI agents. SQLite for agent state. Zero cloud dependencies. Local embeddings. MCP-native integration with Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, Windsurf & more.
